'''Mavra Zane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was a participant in the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. During her time as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Zane wielded a [[Mavra Zane's lightsaber|yellow-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
===Jedi Master===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Mavra Zane was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Constructing a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and growing strong in the Jedi arts under the tutelage of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], Zane achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and was appointed as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. As the threat of [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|separatism]] grew in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], and the discovery of the reemergence of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] loomed large, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] saw a need to expand their training program across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Selecting a group of Jedi Masters, the Council dispatched them with groups of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to open new academies. Master Zane was selected and tasked with leading a group of students to the forested [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where she would instruct her students in the ways of the Force.<ref name="KSW" />

====Kashyyyk====
Traveling aboard a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] with her students, Zane and her charges arrived on Kashyyyk, where they met with Masters Yoda, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Together, Yoda and Zane oversaw the younglings' training. Shortly after their arrival on the world, the [[Jedi outpost (Kashyyyk)|chapter house]] and nearby village were [[Kashyyyk Trade Rebellion|attacked]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and the armies of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. During the first assault, a group effort by the Jedi and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] scattered their attackers and bought time for the Jedi to regroup. Master Yoda used the lull in the fighting to return to Coruscant in hopes of divining the [[Politics/Legends|political]] causes of the attacks.<ref name="KSW" />

Shortly after Yoda left, Zane and her students were forced into battle again. Assisted by a Wookiee named [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], a small group escaped the attack, but Zane and many other students were taken captive. After a brief encounter with the [[Sun Guard]], the students who'd escaped boarded a ship called the ''[[Star Runner]]'', and flew into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to chase the slavers holding Zane and the other Jedi captive. Receiving a transmission from Masters Yoda and Windu via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], the Jedi were notified that Zane and the other captives had been taken to a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility above the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

====Felucia====
[[File:Mavrazane.jpg|thumb|Mavra Zane wielding her yellow lightsaber|left]]
Aboard a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class]] capital ship, Zane freed herself while her escaped Padawans fought their way through the ship's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay to the other imprisoned students. Soon, the Jedi discovered that the Commerce Guild was amassing a huge army to stage an attack on one of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Realizing that the information needed to reach the High Council, Zane met up with the Padawans and warded off an attack by Sun Guards and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. Upon destroying the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], Zane and her students boarded the ''Star Runner'', escaping. Taking critical damage, the ship crash-landed on the planet below.<ref name="KSW" />

Evading enemy combatants, Zane led her students to the planet's resistance stronghold. The native [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]], under the leadership of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Mak Pra]], planned to storm the enemy's base. Agreeing to assist the resistance, Master Zane and her students infiltrated [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai's]] stronghold. Discovering that Mai hoped to weaponize the dangerous chemical [[Trihexalon]] for an attack on Coruscant itself, Zane and her students attempted to escape the compound with this knowledge but were captured by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]]. Presidente Mai ordered the Jedi to be executed and escorted them to the mouth of a massive [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. Before the Jedi could be disposed of, Master Yoda arrived with Republic reinforcements and freed the Jedi.<ref name="KSW" />

[[File:Kinect_knighting.png|thumb|220x220px|Mavra Zane knighting Padawans]]
During the fighting, the Jedi were engaged by two [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]], one of whom was named [[Ror]], and were able to defeat them at the cost of allowing Mai to escape. Zane led the chase into space, determined to stop the Gossam before she reached Coruscant. After a brief conflict over
Felucia, the Commerce Guild's fleet jumped to the capital and the Jedi and the Republic were forced to follow. Flying as [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]], Zane led her squad to destroy the Commerce Guild's fleet, ending the threat to Coruscant. Returning to the Jedi Temple, Master Zane elevated her students to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] with the permission of the High Council.<ref name="KSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mavra Zane was portrayed by veteran voice actress [[Jennifer Hale]] and motion-capture actress/martial artist [[Michelle Lee]].
